# owlf

> owlf connects people who need a local home service with independent local pros, on WhatsApp. A customer describes the job and, where pros are available, up to three send offers. The customer chooses one and pays the pro directly. owlf is free for customers; pros pay a fee only on completed jobs.

Serving: Peterborough, Ontario and nearby towns. Availability depends on the area and the service. The current list of towns is kept up to date at https://app.owlf.one/llms.txt

## Services

- Plumbing
- Electrical
- AC and heating
- Major appliances
- Home maintenance
- Moving and hauling
- Cleaning services
- Lawn and yard care

## Start a request

- [Message owlf on WhatsApp](https://wa.me/12496800033?text=Hi)
- Email: hi@owlf.one
